scope: Simulation task/evidence contract, not field certification

thermal_reference.meaning: Calibrated representative node temperature, not apparent IR pixels

electrical_contact_heat.meaning: Connection temperature only; not supply availability or voltage

control_sensor_bias.meaning: Reference comparison, not ordinary remote temperature alone

IT_service_availability.meaning: Observed IT service deficit; cause remains undiagnosed

ac_voltage.meaning: No actual voltage observation channel in this reduced-order model

branch_current.meaning: A nominal V/power calculation is an estimate, not current measurement

startup_remote_power_calibration: Declared exact public power channels in the synthetic generator; no voltage/current or cause inference
